title: UST grad tops October 2026 Physicians licensure exam
summary: A graduate from the University of Sto. Tomas (UST) has been named topnotcher in the October 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination, according to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).

blocks.text: A graduate from the University of Sto. Tomas (UST) has been named topnotcher in the October 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination, according to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).
Maxine Francesco Gwyneth Cena Baculo garnered a percentage rating of 95.50, the highest among 4,165, who successfully hurdled the examination.
